subscription_products.product_name: Royal Canin Size Health Nutrition Small Adult Dry Dog Food, 14-lb bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Daily nutrition is the highest-frequency need. Tota is a 12-month-old, high-activity Shar Pei at 15 lb. Active small adults ~450–600 kcal/day ≈ 1.25–1.5 cups/day. Use 1.5 cups/day for planning → 1.5 cups × 30 days = 45 cups/month. Typical kibble ≈ 4 cups/lb → 14-lb bag ≈ 56 cups. 56 cups ÷ 45 cups/month ≈ 1.24 months per bag. Autoship keeps food on-hand before running out.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota needs steady, high-quality calories to support that busy, playful Shar Pei energy — this 14-lb adult small-breed formula will get you through about a month-plus between deliveries so you won't run out during training and playtime.

subscription_products.product_name: Smallbatch Pets Shelf Stable Adult Venison Bone Broth Grain-Free Liquid Wet Dog Food Topper, 16-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Hydrating toppers can encourage eating and add electrolytes during warm days and after exercise. If you add ~1 tbsp (0.5 fl oz) per meal as a topper, that's ~1–2 fl oz/week; if you use it more often (e.g., after long walks or high-activity days) plan ~1 fl oz/day. Using a conservative 0.5–1 fl oz/day → 16 fl oz lasts ~2–4 weeks.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota is active and will appreciate a tasty broth after play in the yard or long walks — this shelf-stable bone broth will boost hydration and appetite without messy cans.

subscription_products.product_name: Applaws Taste Toppers Broth Selection Natural Wet Dog Food, 3-oz pouch, case of 6
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Small pouches are handy for daily or occasional topping. If you top 1 meal every other day with a 3-oz pouch, that's ~15 pouches/month. A case of 6 would last ~12 days at that rate — autoship every 2 weeks avoids last-minute runs.
subscription_products.personalized_note: For Tota's busy days, pop a pouch on top of kibble to keep him excited about meal time — great for training days or warm weather when hydration matters.

subscription_products.product_name: BARK Nutty Lil' Starz Peanut Butter & Jelly Flavored Soft & Chewy Dog Training Treats, 6-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Training treats are used multiple times per day. For a young, high-activity dog doing training and recall work, estimate ~6–10 small treats/day. Take 8/day → 240 treats/month. A 6-oz bag of soft mini treats typically provides enough for ~2–4 weeks depending on size; autoship monthly keeps training sessions stocked.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota will love popping these treats during recall and leash-work — I recommend a monthly delivery so positive reinforcement is always on-hand through puppy/adolescent training.

subscription_products.product_name: Pet Botanics Training Rewards Soft & Chewy Puppy Peanut Butter Dog Treats, Mini, 4-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: A second treat option is useful to rotate flavors and avoid boredom. Using smaller mini pieces for rapid reinforcement (estimate 6–8/day) a 4-oz bag will typically last ~2–3 weeks; autoship every 3–4 weeks is appropriate.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Rotate treats for variety — Tota's training will go faster when you have small, soft rewards ready for every success during those apartment training sessions.

subscription_products.product_name: Doggy Do Good Certified Home Compostable Premium Dog & Cat Waste Bags, Small Handle Bags - On Rolls, 180 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Waste bags are high-frequency and predictable. Apartment + small yard usage: estimate 2–3 bags/day (walks + yard cleanup + backup) → 60–90 bags/month. 180-count roll covers ~2–3 months depending on use. Plan autoship every 8 weeks so you're never without bags.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Living in an apartment with a small yard means Tota's walks and potty cleanups happen daily — set-and-forget delivery of 180-count rolls will keep you stocked without cluttering the closet.

subscription_products.product_name: Earth Rated Refill Rolls Compostable Dog Poop Bags, 120 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Alternative bag sizing for portability. Using 2 bags/day → 60/month, 120-count refill lasts ~2 months. If you prefer smaller rolls for purse/backpack, autoship every 8 weeks is sensible.
subscription_products.personalized_note: If you like carrying smaller rolls while out with Tota, these 120-count refills will replace what you use from your dispenser every couple months — great backup for busy weeks.

subscription_products.product_name: Earth Rated Hypoallergenic & Plant Based Soothing Aloe & Chamomile Dog Ear Cleansing Wipes, 60 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Shar Peis have folded ears that trap moisture and wax. Preventive ear cleaning of ~1–2 wipes/week is common. At 2 wipes/week → ~8 wipes/month; a 60-count pack lasts ~7 months. Autoship every 6 months keeps supplies fresh and avoids long gaps in hygiene.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota's breed predisposes him to trapped moisture in the ear folds — keeping wipes on a 6-month schedule helps prevent irritation and vet visits, without overbuying.

subscription_products.product_name: Squishface Wrinkle Wipes Dog Grooming Wipes, 80 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Wrinkle-cleaning is essential for Shar Peis. If you wipe facial/body folds ~1×/day after walks or when damp → 30 wipes/month. 80-count lasts ~2.5 months. Autoship every 3 months maintains a steady supply and prevents infections.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota's facial folds benefit from daily quick wipe-downs — these wrinkle wipes will help you stay on top of that routine so his skin stays clean and comfortable.

subscription_products.product_name: Pet Parents Pet WiPees All Purpose Allergy Dog Wipes, Calming Scent, 100 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Larger multi-use packs are handy for paw/face/coat wiping after yard time. If you use ~10 wipes/week → ~40/month; 100 count lasts ~2.5 months. Autoship every 3 months is convenient.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Keep a pack of general-purpose wipes for quick cleanups after play or walks — Tota's folds and paws will thank you after rainy days in the yard.

subscription_products.product_name: Natural Dog Company Sensitive Skin Dog Shampoo, 12-fl oz bottle

subscription_products.personalized_note: Because Shar Pei skin is sensitive, a gentle shampoo kept on a semi-annual autoship protects Tota from flare-ups and ensures you can bathe him safely after itchy or dirty days.

subscription_products.product_name: Dental Fresh Enzymatic Gel Finger Dog Toothbrush Kit, 2.5-fl oz
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Daily dental care prevents long-term periodontal disease. If you brush/gel once daily, a 2.5-fl oz tube used sparingly lasts ~2–3 months. Autoship every 3 months keeps dental care consistent.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Start a tooth-brushing habit with Tota now — regular enzymatic gel helps keep those young adult teeth healthy and avoids painful problems later.

subscription_products.subscription_rationale: An alternate toothpaste flavor and brush set is useful for variety and travel. At daily use the tube will last 2–3 months; autoship every 3 months keeps a replacement in the drawer.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Tota may prefer different toothpaste flavors on different days — having a brush-and-paste backup on a quarterly schedule makes home dental care simple and consistent.

overall_strategy: Month 1 (cold start) strategy: prioritize setup essentials that make daily life in an apartment easy (food, waste bags, harness/leash, travel water bottle, nail grinder and enrichment tools) plus initial consumables that deplete quickly (food, training treats, toppers, ear/wrinkle wipes, dental gel). Subscriptions are focused on items Tota will use regularly and predictably — primary food (calculation shown), training treats for frequent reinforcement, waste bags for daily cleanup, toppers for appetite/hydration, and grooming/dental consumables on sensible cadences. One-time purchases cover durable gear and enrichment (LED leash, harness, playpen, slow feeders, toys, cooling mat, training clicker) that set up Tota for success without unnecessary repeat buys. I balanced convenience (autoship for high-frequency items) with avoiding over-automation for long-lasting items (one-time buys) while keeping Tota's Shar Pei-specific needs — wrinkle and ear care, heat sensitivity, and high activity — front and center.
